docs.title: SATRAC Production Tracking Module User Guide
1. Introduction
docs.text: This document outlines the guidelines for using the DataWiz application in the Bangalore and Chennai plants for the Production Tracking use case. The application has been optimized to improve user experience and data accuracy.

docs.title: Key Improvements over Previous Version
docs.text:
• Focused tracking: Fewer overall clicks are required to make confirmations.
  • KPI Visibility: Order-level production tracking KPI calculations are surfaced for analysis.
  • Better UI: Includes a quick plant filter, order search, improved QR code printing, and order status tabs.
  • Platform Support: Available for installation on Android, iOS, and Desktop devices.
  • Integrated Modules: Includes a Quality checksheets module (currently disabled).

docs.title: 2. Installation and Login
docs.text: The application URL is https://satrac.datawiz.app. Chrome is the recommended browser.

docs.title: Mobile App Installation
docs.text: Using the mobile app is recommended for making work order confirmations. 1. Open the application URL in your mobile browser. 2. Click on the settings button from the top right corner. 3. Click on the ‘Add to Home Screen’ button. 4. Select the ‘Install’ option. 5. Login using the credentials provided by the DataWiz team.

docs.title: 3. Printing Chassis QR Codes
docs.text: To print QR codes for chassis orders released to the Chennai or Bangalore plants: 1. Login to the app on a Desktop device. 2. From the orders table on the landing page, select the checkboxes for the required orders. 3. Use the filter options or increase the "per page" value to select multiple orders. 4. Select the ‘Print QR’ option to download a PDF containing the unique chassis QR codes.

docs.title: 4. Scanning and Order Details
docs.text: Scan the printed QR code using the DataWiz mobile app to land directly on the order details page.

docs.title: Features on the Details Page
docs.text:
• KPI Cards: View Total Lead Time, Total WIP Aging, Total Cycle Time, and On-Time Status.
  • Stage Tracking: View cycle time and WIP aging for the current stage.
  • Confirmation Actions: Perform start, stop, pause, or confirm actions on the current stage.
  • All Stages: Press the ‘View All Stages’ button to access all details of the stages defined for the order.
  • Documents: Upload or view existing order documents.

docs.title: 5. Making Confirmations
docs.text:
The following actions can be performed to capture production data:

  • START: Press when starting work at a stage to capture start time for cycle calculations.
    • Available for: Subassembly, SFG, Painting, and Finishing.
  • PAUSE / RESUME: Use these buttons if work needs to be temporarily stopped and restarted.
    • Available for: Subassembly, SFG, Painting, and Finishing.
  • COMPLETE: Press when work is finished to capture completion time and input details like line number and supervisor.

docs.title: Confirmation Logs
docs.text:
1. Navigate to the stages section of a specific work order.
  2. Click the ‘View Logs’ button on the right side for each stage.
  3. Logs are sorted from most recent to oldest.
  4. Click ‘View Details’ to see any further information entered by the user during that action.

docs.title: PPC Dashboard
docs.text: Click the ‘View PPC Dashboard’ button on the landing page. * Production Reports: Monthly, Weekly, Daily, and Line-wise trends for SFG, Painting, and Finishing stages. * WIP Aging Reports: Data by stations and aging buckets, provided in both visual and tabular formats. * Sale Order Tracker: Progress for orders with due dates from the last 31 days to the next 31 days. * Plant Filter: Access Chennai and Bangalore plant data separately or together.
